assign.request: Investigate how the voice/chat system creates and updates cards: what card types exist, how a card can be amended, and whether a card can be reduced to an icon and name. Also propose how every request can be visibly tracked with a proposal before work starts, and whether switching a voice model template can reuse the full SDK log to preserve context. Inspect current docs and code, reuse existing Dictate/Servex work where possible, and make no edits; report a concise, reviewable proposal.

decision.question: How should a model-template switch keep context?
options: resume the full SDK transcript with fork:true under the new model
strip thinking blocks into a copied transcript, then resume
decision.chose: test resume+fork first, strip-copy if thinking blocks are rejected, tail stays the fallback
decision.why: OpenRouter runs through the same Agent SDK and session files; the only known risk is signed thinking blocks

decision.question: Proposal before work: approval gate or not?
options: 2-minute visible hold, then start unless changed
decision.chose: 2-minute visible hold, start on go or timeout
decision.why: law 5 forbids blocking on the owner; a short hold still gives a window to redirect
